setup_instructions.step_1: Go to Kibana → Observability → Alerts and rules
setup_instructions.step_2: Click 'Create rule' for each alert in the alert_rules array
setup_instructions.step_3: Configure notification channels in Stack Management → Alerts and Insights → Connectors
setup_instructions.step_4: Test each alert by triggering the condition manually
setup_instructions.step_5: Review alert history regularly and adjust thresholds as needed
